verdict.rationale: Snowflake maintains an official GitHub repo (snowflakedb/snowflake-rest-api-specs) containing OpenAPI-compliant specification files plus importable Postman collections for its REST APIs, which is exactly a downloadable machine-readable API spec; this is corroborated by docs describing the Snowflake REST APIs for resource management and the SQL API. The probe check on docs.snowflake.com/openapi.json 404s, but that doesn't negate the separately hosted official spec repo. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of successfully downloading and using the spec, and no single canonical hosted spec URL on the docs site itself.
